kind: Direct WebSocket send-to-durable-reply diagnostic; not native gate evidence
sourceObservationLimitation: Observed working-tree hashes are metadata, not proof that a frozen binary was built from this source.

method.timing: Monotonic hrtime immediately before ws.send of pre-serialized RPC through arrival of its request-correlated durable reply; arrival stamped before JSON parsing. No browser, debounce or additional pacing.
method.observer: Only scalar metadata, timing/byte counters and one pending request retained. One expected fixture string is used for correctness; no event/document history.
method.durability: Reply follows host persistence; abrupt process SIGKILL/restart validates last acknowledged recovery. This does not simulate hardware power loss.
method.order: Baseline edit_file, candidate edit_file, candidate patch_file, each in a fresh identical disposable fixture.
